Description: The specific DNA change made at this step, in HGVS notation where possible, optionally with the rsID (e.g. rs429358 / NC_000019.10:g.44908684T>C). If several modifications were made at this step, list them in the same order as geneticModificationType. For modifications that do not change the DNA sequence (e.g. RNA interference knock-down), enter "no sequence change".
